result:
Clicking the "olhinho" on a dismissal should no longer raise an internal error. I haven't run the app or the test suite, so this is untested, and I did not add a regression test.

I didn't reproduce the error, so the cause below comes from reading the code. The recent commit "ISSUE #184" added `:enrollment_level` to the controller's columns. The show page uses every column by default, but `Dismissal` has no `enrollment_level` attribute, so the page most likely fails when it tries to read it. That would affect every dismissal, not just some.

The fix is one line in `app/controllers/dismissals_controller.rb`. It sets the show page to display only `:enrollment`, `:dismissal_reason`, `:date` and `:obs`, the same fields as the list.

The new search filters still work, since they use the column's search settings and not the show columns. The list and the create and update forms are unchanged.
